_provenance: The Add Library dialog's settings form, captured from a real PMS 1.43.4: GET /library/sections/prefs?type=<N>&agent=<id> for every library type and agent. `lists["<type>"]` is the list with no agent, a legacy agent or an unknown one; `lists["<type>|<agent>"]` is where an agent changes it. Every setting has one definition across all lists, so each is stored once with its NEW-library default.

hidden.label: Visibility
hidden.summary: Restrict where content from this library should appear.
hidden.enumValues: 0:Include in home screen and global search|1:Exclude from home screen|2:Exclude from home screen and global search

enableCinemaTrailers.label: Enable Cinema Trailers
enableCinemaTrailers.summary: Allow Cinema Trailers to play before items in this library.

enableBIFGeneration.label: Enable video preview thumbnails
enableBIFGeneration.summary: Generate video preview thumbnails for items in this library when enabled in server settings.

collectionMode.label: Collections
collectionMode.summary: How to display collections on the Library tab.
collectionMode.enumValues: 0:Hide collections but show their items|1:Hide items which are in collections|2:Show collections and their items

enableCreditsMarkerGeneration.summary: Detect credits and allow credits skipping for items in this library when enabled in server settings.

enableAdMarkerGeneration.label: Ad detection
enableAdMarkerGeneration.summary: Generate ad markers for items in this library.

enableVoiceActivityGeneration.label: Enable voice activity detection
enableVoiceActivityGeneration.summary: Detect voice activity for items in this library when enabled in server settings. This is required for subtitle auto-sync functionality.

originalTitles.label: Use original titles
originalTitles.summary: Use the original titles for all items regardless of the library language.

localizedArtwork.label: Prefer artwork based on library language
localizedArtwork.summary: Use localized posters when available. This is determined by the library language setting.

useLocalAssets.label: Use local assets
useLocalAssets.summary: When scanning this library, use local posters and artwork if present.

respectTags.label: Prefer local metadata
respectTags.summary: When scanning this library, prefer embedded tags and local files if present.

useExternalExtras.label: Find extras
useExternalExtras.summary: Find trailers and extras automatically (Plex Pass required)

useRedbandTrailers.label: Allow red band trailers
useRedbandTrailers.summary: Use red band (restricted audiences) trailers when available

includeExtrasWithLocalizedSubtitles.label: Localized subtitles
includeExtrasWithLocalizedSubtitles.summary: Include extras with subtitles in Library language

includeAdultContent.label: Allow matching to explicit content
includeAdultContent.summary: Allow matching to adult/pornographic titles and returning adult titles in fix match results. This may hide the title from some features like your Watchlist.

autoCollectionThreshold.label: Minimum automatic collection size
autoCollectionThreshold.summary: Automatically create collections when there are at least the selected number of items for an available collection. Changing this value will have no effect on any existing collections.

ratingsSource.label: Ratings Source
ratingsSource.summary: Select a primary source for ratings.

showOrdering.label: Episode ordering
showOrdering.summary: How the episodes are named on disk.

episodeSort.label: Episode sorting
episodeSort.summary: How to sort the episodes for shows.

enableIntroMarkerGeneration.label: Enable intro detection
enableIntroMarkerGeneration.summary: Detect intros and allow intro skipping for items in this library when enabled in server settings.

albumSort.label: Album sorting
albumSort.summary: How to sort the albums for artists.

enableTrackOffsets.label: Store track progress
enableTrackOffsets.summary: Remember and resume from your previous listening position. Useful for libraries with long-form audio content.

augmentWithSharedContent.label: Include related content from shared libraries
augmentWithSharedContent.summary: Show suggestions and additional albums from libraries shared with you, and include shared tracks in Artist Radio.

artistBios.label: Artist Bios
artistBios.summary: Load artist biography data from the cloud.

albumReviews.label: Album Reviews and Critic Ratings
albumReviews.summary: Load album reviews and critic ratings from the cloud. Might make you reconsider your taste in music.

popularTracks.label: Popular Tracks
popularTracks.summary: Load popular track data, which powers radio stations and the popular tracks area.

useExternalLyrics.label: Find Lyrics
useExternalLyrics.summary: Find lyrics for tracks in this library automatically.

concerts.label: Concerts
concerts.summary: Load concert data for artists, in case you leave the house.

genres.label: Genres
genres.summary: Where to automatically obtain genres for artists and albums.

albumPosters.label: Album Art
albumPosters.summary: Where to automatically obtain album cover art.
albumPosters.enumValues: 2:Plex Music Only|3:Local Files Only|1:Both Plex Music and Local Files
